title: ever LARK|Pleated Chiffon Ruffles Sleeve Midi Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This Pleated Chiffon Ruffles Sleeve Midi Bridesmaid Dress combines elegance and charm. The soft chiffon fabric drapes beautifully, while pleats add texture and movement. The ruffled sleeves enhance its feminine silhouette, making it a perfect choice for bridesmaids looking for style and comfort at weddings.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length:Tea length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

 

Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
